verdict.rationale: Team review workflows are a fair question for a fraud-protection platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents order submission, fraud decisions, Decision Center policies and webhooks. Nothing describes reviewer assignment, escalation, review SLAs, or an audit trail showing who approved a decision and why.

support.subject: As an ops user, review work is a team workflow — assignment, escalation, SLAs, and a decision audit trail that shows who approved what and why
